title: EASy Inbound Jobs - Operations Dashboard v1.1

panels.title: Jobs Completed
panels.description: Completed EASy job executions in the selected dashboard time range.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, message, job_name
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /status=COMPLETED|Job exit status \(COMPLETED\)|finished with status COMPLETED/
| stats count() as completed_jobs

panels.title: Job Failures
panels.description: FAILED executions and ALERT-level job failures.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, message, job_name, `log.level`
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /status=FAILED|Job exit status \(FAILED\)|finished with status FAILED/
    or `log.level` = "ALERT"
| stats count() as failed_jobs

panels.title: Stopped Jobs
panels.description: Jobs stopped by a listener, volume threshold, concurrency protection, or manual action.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, message, job_name
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /status=STOPPED|job was stopped|Stopped by ParallelLockoutListener/
| stats count() as stopped_jobs

panels.title: ALERT / ERROR Events
panels.description: Structured application events with log.level ALERT or ERROR.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, message, job_name, `log.level`
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter `log.level` in ["ALERT","ERROR"]
| stats count() as alert_error_events

panels.title: Incoming Queue
panels.description: Messages waiting on the EASy inbound queue.

panels.title: DLQ Messages
panels.description: Messages in the EASy dead-letter queue.

panels.title: Inbound Queue Flow
panels.description: SQS activity across file arrival, worker receipt, and successful message deletion.

panels.title: Queue Backlog & Oldest Message
panels.description: Shows stalled intake processing and growing queue latency.

panels.title: Application Pipeline Timeline
panels.description: Chronological business-processing events across stage, process, reconcile, target, and completion.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `log.level`, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /Starting job|launching|Stage|Process|Reconcile|Target|status=COMPLETED|status=FAILED|status=STOPPED|finished with status/
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 300

panels.title: Latest Status by Job
panels.description: Last observed state and status counts for each EASy job.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /status=COMPLETED|status=FAILED|status=STOPPED|Job exit status|finished with status/
| parse message /status[= ](?<status>COMPLETED|FAILED|STOPPED)/
| stats latest(@timestamp) as last_event,
        latest(status) as last_status,
        countif(status="COMPLETED") as completed,
        countif(status="FAILED") as failed,
        countif(status="STOPPED") as stopped
  by job_name
| sort last_event desc

panels.title: Latest Job Execution Events
panels.description: Most recent start, initialization, launch, completion, failure, and stopped events.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `log.level`, message, `error.type`, `error.message`
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /Starting job|Initializing job|launching|status=COMPLETED|status=FAILED|status=STOPPED|finished with status/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

fields @timestamp, job_name, message, `error.type`, `error.message`
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter `error.type` in ["FlatFileParseException","IncorrectLineLengthException","BindException"]
    or message like /FlatFileParseException|IncorrectLineLengthException|BindException/
| stats count() as parse_errors

fields @timestamp, job_name, message, `error.type`, `error.message`
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter `error.type` in ["ConstraintViolationException","DataIntegrityViolationException","TransientPropertyValueException"]
    or message like /ConstraintViolationException|DataIntegrityViolationException|TransientPropertyValueException/
| stats count() as constraint_errors

fields @timestamp, job_name, message, `error.type`, `error.message`
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /duplicate ABA|Duplicate ABA|same ABA/
    or `error.message` like /duplicate ABA|Duplicate ABA/
| stats count() as duplicate_aba_events

fields @timestamp, job_name, message, `error.type`, `error.message`
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /Missing lookup|lookup failed|NULL foreign key|reference data/
    or `error.message` like /lookup|foreign key/
| stats count() as lookup_failures

fields @timestamp, job_name, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /Skipped in step|Skip limit exceeded|records skipped/
| stats count() as skipped_events

panels.title: UPDATE_ID Events
panels.description: UPDATE_ID and unchanged-record events. These are informational because older sequence IDs may be expected.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /UPDATE_ID|marked.*unchanged|stale data/
| stats count() as update_id_events

panels.title: Data Quality Events
panels.description: Detailed data-quality failures and expected UPDATE_ID sequencing events.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `log.level`, `error.type`, `error.message`, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /FlatFileParseException|IncorrectLineLengthException|BindException|ConstraintViolationException|DataIntegrityViolationException|TransientPropertyValueException|duplicate ABA|Duplicate ABA|Missing lookup|lookup failed|Skipped in step|Skip limit exceeded|UPDATE_ID/
    or `error.type` in ["FlatFileParseException","IncorrectLineLengthException","BindException","ConstraintViolationException","DataIntegrityViolationException","TransientPropertyValueException"]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 250

panels.title: Exception Breakdown
panels.description: Counts exceptions such as file-not-found, parse, bind, integrity, constraint, and null-pointer failures.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `error.type`, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter ispresent(`error.type`) or message like /Exception/
| stats count() as occurrences by `error.type`
| sort occurrences desc

panels.title: Recent Failures and Stopped Jobs
panels.description: Actionable failures, stop conditions, skip-limit breaches, and structured application alerts.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `log.level`, `error.type`, `error.message`, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter `log.level` in ["ALERT","ERROR"]
    or message like /status=FAILED|status=STOPPED|job was stopped|Skip limit exceeded/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: Critical Operations: Reconcile, Tiering & Merge
panels.description: Dedicated visibility for weekly reconciliation, settlement-tier calculation, and high-risk merge/split operations.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `log.level`, message, `error.type`, `error.message`
| filter job_name like /easyIrdReconcileLoadJob|calcSettlementTiersJob|mergeSplitOrgsJob/
| filter message like /Starting job|status=COMPLETED|status=FAILED|status=STOPPED|rollback|constraint|tier|reconcile|merge/
    or `log.level` in ["ALERT","ERROR"]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: ECS CPU and Memory
panels.description: Runtime utilization for the ECS service that executes the EASy inbound jobs.

panels.title: ECS Task Health
panels.description: Requires ECS Container Insights. Shows running and pending service tasks.

panels.title: Long-Running Job Events
panels.description: Long-running job detections documented by the BatchJob listener.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /Found the following potential long running jobs|long running|execution time/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

panels.title: Concurrency & Lockout Events
panels.description: Parallel execution prevention and concurrent-modification conflicts.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter message like /Stopped by ParallelLockoutListener due to other executions|concurrent execution|optimistic lock/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

panels.title: Filtered Application Logs
panels.description: Use the Job Name and Log Level variables to investigate structured EASy application logs.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `log.level`, `log.logger`, `error.type`, `error.message`, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter `log.level` like /${log_level:raw}/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500

panels.title: ALERT / ERROR Log Stream
panels.description: Focused operator view of the playbook-defined ALERT and ERROR log levels.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, job_name, `log.level`, `error.type`, `error.message`, message
| filter job_name like /${job_name:raw}/
| filter `log.level` in ["ALERT","ERROR"]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 300

panels.title: End-to-End Pipeline Map
panels.description: Operator-oriented view of the EASy inbound file, queue, ECS, batch-job, and Compass data flow.

options.content:
## EASy Inbound Processing Flow

**NIS / EASy Source**  
↓  
**S3 Incoming Files**  
`adt-frfs-compass-${env}-${region_short}-s3-incoming-files`  
↓  
**SQS Incoming Queue**  
`${sqs_queue}`  
↓  
**ECS Data Acquisition Service**  
`${ecs_cluster}` / `${ecs_service}`  
↓  
**Spring Batch Jobs**  
Profile & Address → IAS → Compass Data → Billing  
IRD Daily → Settlement Tiers  
Weekly: Profile Verify / IRD Reconcile  
On-demand: Merge Split  
↓  
**Compass Target Tables**

### Failure branches

- **Queue processing failure** → `${dlq_queue}`
- **Application failure** → `log.level = ALERT` or `ERROR`
- **Data-quality failure** → parse, bind, lookup, duplicate ABA, constraint, or skip-limit event
- **Concurrency protection** → `ParallelLockoutListener`

## First-response triage

1. **Check Executive Health**
   - Job failures
   - Stopped jobs
   - ALERT / ERROR events
   - Queue depth
   - DLQ count

2. **Check infrastructure**
   - ECS CPU and memory
   - Running and pending tasks
   - Queue backlog and oldest message

3. **Check the job lifecycle**
   - Latest status by job
   - Recent start/completion/failure events
   - Long-running or lockout events

4. **Check data quality**
   - Parse or bind errors
   - Constraint violations
   - Duplicate ABA
   - Missing lookup data
   - Skip-limit events

5. **Escalate using the playbook path**
   - Infrastructure → job execution → Compass AppDev → Product Owner → EASy source team

## Common issue guide

### File not found
Look for `FileNotFoundException`. Verify file arrival, path, and permissions.

### Parse or line-length error
Look for:
- `FlatFileParseException`
- `IncorrectLineLengthException`
- `BindException`

Validate the fixed-width layout and encoding.

### Duplicate ABA
Look for `ConstraintViolationException` and duplicate-ABA text. Investigate organization data and whether Merge Split is appropriate.

### Missing lookup data
Look for failed lookup, null foreign-key, or reference-data messages. Confirm prerequisite/reference data jobs ran.

### Stopped job
Check whether the cause was:
- volume threshold
- parallel execution
- manual stop
- skip limit

### Merge Split failure
Treat as high risk. Confirm full rollback and no partial updates before retrying.

## Operational notes

### Typical schedules
- **Daily morning:** Profile & Address
- **After Profile Load:** IAS and Compass Data
- **After data loads:** Billing
- **Mon–Fri:** IRD Daily
- **Triggered by IRD:** Settlement Tiers
- **Weekly off-hours:** Profile Verify and IRD Reconcile
- **On-demand:** Merge Split

### Skip limits
- Profile & Address: **50**
- IAS / IRD / Compass Data: **5**
- Merge Split: **No skips; all-or-nothing**

### UPDATE_ID behavior
An incoming `UPDATE_ID` older than the stored value may correctly result in an unchanged record. Treat isolated events as informational; investigate unusual increases or sequencing failures.

### Critical alert conditions
- DLQ messages greater than zero
- `log.level = ALERT` or `ERROR`
- job status `FAILED`
- skip limit exceeded
- long-running job detection
- `ParallelLockoutListener`
